selection: Contiguous publisher shard order after the two development shards. Retain every scene in every selected shard. No replacement based on difficulty, tracking quality, reference availability, or method performance.
phase: Acquire and process calibration shards only. Reserved evaluation shards remain unopened until calibrated multipliers and downstream evaluation rules are frozen.
input_policy: Separate RGB and reference archives. Image inference reads only RGB. Reference geometry is used only after per-scene image outputs are frozen. No MOVi test shards or TAPVid calibration images/exports are opened.
image_checks: Same 64 frame-zero queries x,y=12,44,...,236; all 24 native frames for pinned CoTracker3 forward inference; target frames 12,18,23; reverse target-frame-to-zero prefixes; forward and reverse visibility and finite in-image reverse query eligibility unchanged. No camera inference is needed to calibrate correspondence error.
learned_scale: The cycle-only .9 log-error quantile model from error-quantiles-v1.json, copied verbatim into model.json. Radius scale is max(1 pixel, predicted error). No coefficient, feature, quantile, penalty, or visibility-threshold changes.
score: For each scene and each fixed scale, take the maximum reference error divided by that scale over forward-and-reverse-visible points with supported reference projections. Report all eligible but unlabeled points separately. A scene with no labeled eligible point contributes an unbounded score rather than being dropped.
calibration: For each of the three scales, use the ceil((n+1)*0.95) order statistic of all scene scores, including unbounded scores. Rank beyond n or an unbounded selected score yields an unbounded multiplier. Use one scene as one calibration unit, not one point or frame.
reference_policy: Use unchanged background depth/mask non-rejection and foreground depth/mask/normal support rules from the existing audits. These are renderer-derived diagnostic visibility cues, not certified physical visibility. The target event is containment of supported eligible reference projections, not all physical points.
failure_policy: Retain every acquisition, decoding, inference, and scoring failure. Do not replace scenes or silently lower n. Failed or wholly unlabeled calibration scenes cannot supply a finite score.
reporting: All three scales remain in the comparison. Report scene-level simultaneous containment, pointwise containment, radii, eligibility and label coverage, and all failures. No favorable scale is selected using evaluation outcomes.
limitations: Scene exchangeability and independence are assumptions, not established by publisher shard order. Frozen-model pretraining overlap is unknown. Correspondence calibration alone does not certify staticness, camera quality, placement usability, or functional DNF, and is not itself a novel contribution. The reserved evaluation set is not a camera-method holdout.
